question: Does public ForecastBench baseline leaderboard exhibit heterogeneity of evaluated question counts across model rows, making naive Brier comparison across unequal N problematic?
plan: Parse full CSV with quote-aware parser; calculate min/max distinct positive N dataset and N market for non-reference model rows, missingness and N sum check. Negative control: verify N overall equals N dataset+N market for each complete row. Do not compute novel score or causal effect.
threshold: At least two distinct positive N dataset values and >=1 valid complete row; otherwise falsified
interpretation: Descriptive audit only; difficulty-adjusted Brier is prior art, not new invention
ethics: Aggregated public model leaderboard only; no individual human data
R5: STOP if connector returns truncated CSV or rows invalid; record failure
budget: One phase I cycle if A-J completed
